# inei

> EXIF and XMP metadata parser for JPEG, PNG, and HEIC/HEIF/AVIF images. TypeScript. Zero dependencies.

## What this library does

inei reads image metadata from binary image files. It accepts an ArrayBuffer, Uint8Array, Buffer, Blob, or File and returns structured EXIF tags, XMP data, image dimensions, and embedded thumbnails.

Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, HEIC, HEIF, AVIF. Format is auto-detected from magic bytes.

## Install

```
npm install inei
```

## Core API

```typescript
import { parseExif } from "inei";

const result = parseExif(buffer);
// Returns: { ok: true, data: ParsedExif } | { ok: false, error: ExifError }

if (result.ok) {
  result.data.tags;          // { Make: "Canon", Model: "EOS R6", ISO: 400, FNumber: 2.8, ... }
  result.data.image;         // { width: 5472, height: 3648 }
  result.data.xmp;           // { title: "My Photo", subject: ["landscape"], rating: 5 }
  result.data.thumbnail;     // { type, offsetFromTiff, length, absoluteOffset }
  result.data.formattedTags; // only present when includeFormatted: true
}
```

### Async (browser File/Blob input)

```typescript
import { parseExifFromBlob } from "inei";
const result = await parseExifFromBlob(file);
```

### Convenience functions

```typescript
import { gps, orientation, thumbnail, thumbnailUrl } from "inei";

gps(buffer);          // { latitude: 37.7749, longitude: -122.4194 } | undefined
orientation(buffer);  // 1-8 | undefined
thumbnail(buffer);    // Uint8Array | undefined
thumbnailUrl(buffer); // "blob:..." | undefined (browser only)
```

### Options

```typescript
parseExif(buffer, {
  simplifyValues: true,     // rationals→floats, dates→epoch seconds, GPS→decimal degrees
  imageSize: true,          // extract width/height from container
  includeFormatted: false,  // add formattedTags with human-readable strings
  hidePointers: true,       // omit internal IFD pointer tags
  readBinaryTags: false,    // include UNDEFINED (binary blob) tags
  returnTags: true,         // include the tag map
  resolveTagNames: true,    // map tag IDs to names
});
```

### Formatted output

```typescript
const result = parseExif(buffer, { includeFormatted: true });
result.data.formattedTags;
// { Shutter: "1/800", Aperture: "f/10", ISO: "ISO 400", FocalLength: "50mm",
//   Make: "Canon", Model: "EOS R6", LensModel: "RF50mm F1.2 L USM",
//   GPS: "37.77° N, 122.42° W", DateTimeOriginal: "Oct 22, 2023, 6:46 PM", ... }
```

### Individual formatters (inei/format)

```typescript
import { formatShutter, formatAperture, formatFocalLength, formatDate,
         formatOrientation, formatExposureCompensation, formatExposureProgram,
         formatMeteringMode, formatFlash, formatGPSCoordinate } from "inei/format";
```

### Batch formatter (inei/format-tags)

```typescript
import { computeFormattedTags } from "inei/format-tags";
const formatted = computeFormattedTags(result.data.tags);
```

### XMP parser (inei/xmp)

```typescript
import { parseXmp } from "inei/xmp";
const data = parseXmp(xmlString);
// { title, description, creator, subject, rating, label, createDate }
```

### Thumbnail extraction

```typescript
import { parseExif, extractThumbnail } from "inei";
const result = parseExif(buffer);
if (result.ok) {
  const bytes = extractThumbnail(buffer, result.data); // Uint8Array of JPEG thumbnail
}
```

## Key types

```typescript
interface ParsedExif {
  image?: { width: number; height: number };
  tags: Partial<ExifTagMap>;
  tagsRaw: Record<string, unknown>;
  thumbnail?: ThumbnailInfo;
  formattedTags?: Record<string, string>;
  xmp?: XmpData;
}

interface ExifTagMap {
  Make?: string; Model?: string; ISO?: number; FNumber?: number;
  ExposureTime?: number; ExposureCompensation?: number; ExposureProgram?: number;
  FocalLength?: number; FocalLengthIn35mmFormat?: number;
  LensMake?: string; LensModel?: string;
  DateTimeOriginal?: number | string; CreateDate?: number | string; ModifyDate?: number | string;
  GPSLatitude?: number; GPSLongitude?: number; GPSAltitude?: number;
  Orientation?: 1|2|3|4|5|6|7|8;
  Flash?: number; MeteringMode?: number; WhiteBalance?: number;
  ImageWidth?: number; ImageHeight?: number;
  [custom: string]: unknown;
}

interface XmpData {
  title?: string; description?: string; creator?: string;
  subject?: string[]; rating?: number; label?: string; createDate?: string;
}

class ExifError extends Error {
  code: "NOT_JPEG" | "NO_EXIF" | "INVALID_TIFF" | "TRUNCATED" | "UNKNOWN";
}
```

## Error handling

parseExif never throws. Returns `{ ok: false, error: ExifError }` on failure.
Convenience functions (gps, orientation, thumbnail, thumbnailUrl) return undefined on failure.

## Constraints

- ESM only
- Reads full buffer into memory (no streaming/chunked reads)
- No IPTC, ICC, or MakerNote support
